knownTestFixtureLimitations: Default stories for Form, Table, Tree and UploadArea contain automatic play functions that change focus or state before a manual keyboard audit.
Neutral keyboard-only stories without play should be added before this audit becomes an automated release gate.
decision: Q-04.6 was executed but did not pass. Remediation is required before the accessibility gate can close.
